name: Dogu Aras Enerji Yatirimlari AS
summary: Dogu Aras Enerji Yatirimlari AS (DAEYAS) operates primarily within the energy sector, handling both the distribution and retail sale of energy. The company's distribution services reach an estimated 1,081,853 customers across 58 districts within seven provinces: Erzurum, Agri, Ardahan, Bayburt, Erzincan, Kars, and Igdir. Additionally, DAEYAS provides energy retail services nationwide throughout Turkey. This enterprise was established in 2013 and maintains its corporate headquarters in Yakutiye, Turkey.
